DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Myelopathy (likely due to spondylotic myelopathy or spinal cord compression).

I have noted your age and the 3-month progression of gait difficulty requiring a wheelchair, along with a 1-year history of incontinence and recent speech changes. These symptoms strongly suggest cervical spine pathology affecting the long tracts and corticospinal tracts. To confirm this, I need to see imaging of your cervical spine.
